title: Degree-zero affine cohomology localization comparison
statement: Let Y be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], L an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], s a global section of L, and F a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent]. Let U be an open with underlying set the nonvanishing locus of s [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. The additive fraction presentation CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s 0 top [def-sc-cohomology-fraction-presentation] is additively equivalent to H^0(U,F) [def-sc-open-module-cohomology], by an equivalence e such that for every n >= 0 and t in H^0(Y,F tensor L^n), multiplication by s^n on H^0(U,F) sends e(t/s^n) to the restriction of t to U. Multiplication means the morphism F -> F tensor L^n induced by the right-unitor inverse and tensorPowSection, as in the fraction presentation.

source.place: Lemma 09MR affine case, degree-zero paragraph; Properties Tag 01PW

proof.text: Sections on an open are left exact. Apply the canonical zeroth right-derived isomorphism, natural both in module morphisms and in section restriction.

Take the direct sum of the zeroth-cohomology/sections additive equivalences. Naturality transports the fraction generators. The additive closure of the section relations equals their module span because r times the relation for t is the relation for r*t. Hence the direct-sum equivalence descends to the fraction quotients and preserves generators.

Apply [lem-sc-affine-section-localization]. Its open equals U by set extensionality. Compose the fraction quotient equivalence, the section localization equivalence, and the inverse of the zeroth-cohomology/sections equivalence on U.

Under the zeroth-cohomology/sections equivalence, the right-unitor and tensorPowSection map is tensor multiplication by the restricted power of s. The section localization formula and naturality of restriction give the required cohomology formula by injectivity.
